title: Record evidence where it can be found again
when: A recipe, help text or refusal is wrong or missing, or a bug sits outside the task
need: File one field note for that problem before moving on, with the kind that matches it. Link a repeat to the first note. A note is a supporting learning record, not automatically an executable work item.
surface: Generated AGENTS/skill directive -> field-note append help; public Ouroboros page.
